candidates.snippet: -1303: Ascension to the throne - Ramesses II ascended to the throne of Egypt, beginning his long and influential reign as pharaoh. -1274: Battle of Kadesh - Ramesses II led Egyptian forces in the Battle of Kadesh against the Hittite Empire, a pivotal event in ancient Near Eastern history. -1258: Egyptian-Hittite peace treaty - Ramesses II signed the earliest known peace treaty with the Hittite Empire, establishing a lasting peace between the two powers. -1213: Death of Ramesses II - Ramesses II died after a reign of 66 years, leaving behind a legacy of monumental architecture and political stability.
